recommendations.issue: Inconsistent food preparation, use of lower quality ingredients, or issues with recipe execution.
recommendations.action: Implement a comprehensive kitchen audit, including ingredient quality checks, standardized recipe adherence training for all kitchen staff, and regular taste tests by management.
recommendations.expected_impact: Significant improvement in food consistency and taste, leading to higher customer satisfaction and repeat visits.

recommendations.issue: Lack of proper staff training, insufficient staffing leading to stress, or poor management oversight of service standards.
recommendations.action: Develop and implement mandatory customer service training for all front-of-house staff, focusing on positive attitude, conflict resolution, and proactive guest engagement. Review staffing levels during peak hours.
recommendations.expected_impact: Enhanced customer experience, reduced negative service reviews, and improved staff morale.

recommendations.issue: Pricing strategy not aligned with customer expectations or perceived value, or potentially rising ingredient costs not justified by the final product/experience.
recommendations.action: Conduct a competitive pricing analysis and a cost-benefit analysis of menu items. Consider adjusting prices, enhancing portion sizes, or introducing value-driven specials to better align with customer perceived value.
recommendations.expected_impact: Increased customer satisfaction with value for money, potentially leading to higher sales volume and improved profitability.

recommendations.issue: Broad operational inefficiencies, lack of attention to detail in overall customer experience, or specific un-categorized problems.
recommendations.action: Implement a customer feedback system (e.g., digital surveys, comment cards) to identify specific 'other' issues. Conduct a full operational review to pinpoint general inefficiencies.
recommendations.expected_impact: Uncover and address hidden operational flaws, leading to a more seamless and positive overall customer experience.

recommendations.issue: Understaffing, inefficient kitchen operations, poor order management, or high customer volume without adequate capacity.
recommendations.action: Analyze peak hour staffing levels and kitchen workflow. Implement a new order management system or optimize kitchen layout/processes to reduce bottlenecks.
recommendations.expected_impact: Shorter wait times, improved customer satisfaction, and increased table turnover.

recommendations.issue: Outdated decor, poor lighting, uncomfortable seating, excessive noise, or lack of regular maintenance.
recommendations.action: Conduct a walk-through audit of the dining area to identify specific ambience issues. Prioritize minor aesthetic upgrades (e.g., lighting, music, minor decor changes) or address noise reduction.
recommendations.expected_impact: A more pleasant and inviting dining environment, enhancing the overall customer experience.

recommendations.issue: Inadequate cleaning protocols, insufficient staff for cleaning, or lack of regular maintenance checks.
recommendations.action: Review and update daily/weekly cleaning checklists and schedules. Assign clear responsibilities for cleanliness checks and consider increasing cleaning staff hours if necessary.
recommendations.expected_impact: A visibly cleaner and more hygienic environment, improving customer comfort and perception of quality.
